raw_segments.text: Near the wooden portico below, built onto the outer wall of the precinct, there was
a crowd of about 20 peasant women.
They had been told that the elder was at last coming out, and they had gathered together
Two ladies, Madame Holikov and her daughter, had also come out into the portico to wait
for the elder, but in a separate part of it set aside for women of rank.
